shared_elements: repeated figures arranged in a directional procession/row
rows of small repeated marks (crew strokes / rosette band) forming a border-like register
justification: The only real correspondence is that both surfaces show repeated figures aligned in profile rows moving in a common direction, with rows of small repeated strokes/motifs reading as a register band; this is a generic organisational convention rather than a shared motif. A depicts naturalistic modelled humans in belted garments leading a humped camel between floral rosette borders, while B depicts purely linear schematic ships with hulls, upturned prows and comb-like crew strokes, with no humans, animals or floral motifs at all.
